```sql
SELECT
  CAST(asia_pop AS DOUBLE) / CAST(world_pop AS DOUBLE) AS asia_population_ratio
FROM
  (SELECT SUM(ch.population) AS asia_pop
   FROM main.country_history ch
   JOIN main.country c ON ch.code = c."Code"
   WHERE c."Continent" = 'Asia'
     AND ch.effective_month = '2026-05') num,
  (SELECT SUM(ch.population) AS world_pop
   FROM main.country_history ch
   WHERE ch.effective_month = '2026-04') den;
```
